relation_to_v1: X1 models are NEW versions (2.0.0) of the X0 models; their arithmetic is IDENTICAL to v1 (same execution rule, same latency values, same slippage arithmetic, same stale / data-quality rules). v2 changes only classification, provenance labelling and documented purpose, as required by P2-X1. contracts/models_v1.json stays byte-identical and keeps governing every v1 estimate.

execution_models.definition: marketable (taker) order; long-only: entry = BUY against the ask, exit = SELL against the bid of the PIT book state at execution_time; fill = touch adjusted by the declared slippage model; no partial fills, no limit orders, no shorting
execution_models.touch_source: bookTicker book record (type=book), latest with available_at_ms <= execution_time
execution_models.decision_reference_source: bookTicker book record, latest with available_at_ms <= decision_time
execution_models.reference_price: decision mid (analytic reference, never a fill) and execution-time touch (the executable reference)

latency_models.definition: execution_time = decision_time (idealized, instantaneous; a lower-bound reference)

latency_models.justification: a round, order-of-magnitude research value: above the MEASURED warm public-REST round trip from this host (min-of-3 RTT 251-296 ms) and of the order of the MEASURED first-request round trip after idling (median about 1.04 s); aligned with the 1 s collector sample grid. The order path (decision, processing, order creation, order-entry network, matching, acknowledgement, fill report) is UNAVAILABLE, so 1 s is NOT evidenced as an end-to-end latency
stress sensitivity: 5 x the base value (slow decision loop, queueing, retries); equals the Tier-2 depth cadence; not derived from any return
latency_models.not: an observed order latency or a prediction

latency_resolution_limit: the data resolve a latency only to the sampling cadence of the stream: book T0 1 s, T2 2 s, T1 10 s; depth T0 1 s, T2 5 s, T1 60 s. Measured on eligible sealed data: at T+1 s the Tier-1 book record equals the T record in 873 / 875 cases and the Tier-1 depth snapshot in 875 / 875; at T+5 s the Tier-1 depth snapshot is still the T snapshot in 875 / 875. Latency sensitivity is therefore partly invisible for Tier 1 and must be read together with the reconstruction state (confirmed_exact vs latest_persisted_only)

latency_decomposition.rule: every component carries one class; the end-to-end decision-to-fill latency is ASSUMED (the scenario value) because the order path components are UNAVAILABLE. A MEASURED network observation to a public market-data endpoint is a lower-bound observation, not proof of any end-to-end value

components.evidence: observed_at_ms - exchange_event_time_ms on eligible sealed data: p50 176 ms, p99 1.7 s (host clock vs exchange clock, skew -23..-2 ms not removed, includes exchange-side batching); book / depth carry no exchange event time -> UNAVAILABLE for the streams that set the touch

components.component: signal_decision (strategy computation from data availability to decision)
components.evidence: no strategy is evaluated in P2-X; research decision times are grid instants; Paper decision timing is not read (forbidden) and not instrumented for research
no order code path, no credentials (forbidden)

proxy.what: round trip t1 - t0 of the collector's public REST probe /api/v3/time (public market-data host, not the order-entry endpoint)
proxy.evidence: eligible sealed data, 194 clock checks x 3 probes: min-of-3 RTT 250.7-295.5 ms (p50 262 ms); warm probes (positions 1-2) median about 263 ms; first probe after about 10 min idle median about 1.04 s, max 2.6 s

components.evidence: no order submitted, no acknowledgement timestamps
no fills, no partial fills, no commissions
collector clock checks: skew -22.9..-2.3 ms with uncertainty (RTT/2) 125-148 ms; needed for any future reconciliation of host and exchange timestamps

slippage_models.definition: fill = touch exactly (declared zero slippage beyond the touch); a lower-bound reference
fill = touch * (1 + side * 0 bps): the zero point of the sensitivity table

slippage_models.anchor: P2-D0 protocol section 9 slippage sensitivity +5 bps per side (itself a predeclared, unfitted policy value)
P2-D0 protocol section 9 slippage sensitivity +10 bps per side (predeclared, unfitted); NOT a 'realistic' value
none: a bounded what-if (2.5 x the assumed fee unit)

slippage_models.definition: walk the PIT depth snapshot (latest with available_at_ms <= execution_time) on the order side for order_notional: BUY spends order_notional quote across asks ascending; SELL sells order_notional / depth_L1_bid base across bids descending; s = side * (vwap - depth_L1) / depth_L1 (relative to the snapshot's own level 1); fill = book touch * (1 + side * s)
unavailable_when: depth INVALID (too stale, missing, previous run, not observing)
order_notional exceeds the displayed notional of the side (never extrapolated)
slippage_models.truth_boundary: a lower bound on the cost of consuming DISPLAYED liquidity at the snapshot instant; not market impact, not realized slippage (terminology_v2.json truth_boundary)
slippage_models.known_limitation: the snapshot can be older than the book touch (Tier-1 depth age at execution timestamps about 30-41 s; at the EXEC-BASE timestamp T + 1 s its level 1 crosses the newer book touch in 33.9 % (buy) / 31.3 % (sell) of Tier-1 cases, 6.5 % / 6.3 % Tier 2, 10.0 % / 8.1 % Tier 0): flagged depth_book_inconsistent, the walk is then a ladder SHAPE estimate

stress_values_classification.result: ASSUMED SENSITIVITY SCENARIOS: 0 = PURE_SENSITIVITY (zero point), 5 and 10 = POLICY_OR_LITERATURE_INSPIRED (P2-D0 protocol values, themselves unfitted), 25 = PURE_SENSITIVITY. None is EMPIRICALLY_CALIBRATED (that requires realized fills; none exist). 10 bps is not called realistic.
stress_values_classification.kept_because: they are small, bounded, predeclared and keep P2-D comparability; they bracket unobserved effects (quotes superseded inside a sampling interval, replenishment, impact) that the displayed-depth walk cannot see. No value was changed, so no new arithmetic version is needed (v2 only relabels)

stale_policies.source: the collector's own semantics read from the run record of the boot that wrote the record (semantics.stale_ms, sampling_profile.cadence_ms); defaults = SCHEMA.md values. No threshold is derived from any return.

book.TOO_STALE: quote_age_ms > hard limit (Tier 0: stale_ms.book_t0; Tier 1/2: stale_ms.book_t12_dead)
book.DEGRADED: quote_age_ms > soft limit (Tier 0: stale_ms.book_t0; Tier 1/2: stale_ms.book_t12_suspect)

threshold_classification.evidence: documented as a dead-stream / no-change bound for an event-driven stream; eligible sealed data: Tier-0 book age at execution timestamps max 2.7 s, at persisted boundaries max 7.2 s

a health warning bound; it coincides with the collector hold window (120 s) that already caps persisted ages; observed max 81.8 s (T1) / 116.2 s (T2) at boundaries, 33 s / 78 s at execution timestamps
dead-stream bound; never reachable by a persisted boundary (hold window 120 s) and pre-empted by the 3 x cadence confirmation rule
persistence bound set from push inter-arrival (about 1 s); persisted ages are censored at it (max 1.99 s); execution-timestamp age <= 0.85 s; no execution-quality rationale documented
cadence multiple; execution-timestamp age p99 3.5 s, max 12 s

cadence multiple; it admits a 30-41 s old Tier-1 snapshot at every execution timestamp, whose level 1 crosses the newer book touch in about a third of cases: as an execution-quality threshold it would be INSUFFICIENTLY_SUPPORTED

threshold_classification.threshold: confirmation MISSING > 3 x cadence; DEGRADED > cadence
threshold_classification.evidence: the collector HEALTHY rule / freshness classes

stale_policies.result: no collector threshold is a DEFENSIBLE_RESEARCH_THRESHOLD; all are used as POLICY values with provenance ASSUMED. No new threshold is introduced (none could be justified without outcome data)

states.INVALID: fail closed: execution price UNAVAILABLE (never a favorable or fallback fill)

data_quality_policies.rules: identical to X0-DQ 1.0.0 (contracts/models_v1.json): invalid / degraded / informational rules, depth rules gate X1-S2 only, load-level ambiguity and seal checks

refusals.reason: no trade prints, no queue position, no hidden / iceberg liquidity, depth is a sampled top-N snapshot (truth boundary)
no order is ever submitted; no fills
no order-book event stream between samples; no fills
a future post-entry LABEL, kept distinct from slippage
